knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

pacman::p_load(GaitiLabUtils, GBMutils, glue, data.table, tidyverse, stringr, rjson, Seurat)

logr <- init_logging()

```{r}
log_info("Load color palette...")
palette <- GBMutils::load_color_palette("Spatial_CellClass_L2")

log_info("Load Seurat object...")
seurat_obj <- readRDS(params$seurat_obj_path)

log_info("Set default assay")
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "cell_type"
print(seurat_obj)
```


```{r}
log_info("Load scRNAseq DE results...")
DE_markers_scRNAseq <- read.csv(params$DE_markers_scRNAseq) %>%
    # Only keep genes that are in the xenium data
    filter(gene %in% rownames(seurat_obj), cluster != "NoSignals") %>%
    # Combine cell types -> broader cell type annotation
    mutate(
        cluster = case_when(
            cluster %in% c("Glutamatergic", "GABAergic") ~ "Neuron",
            cluster %in% c("Endothelial") ~ "BV",
            cluster %in% c("Myeloid_Inflammatory", "Myeloid_Immunosuppressive") ~ "Myeloid",
            .default = cluster
        ),
        p_val_adj = ifelse(p_val_adj == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_val_adj),
        score = -log10(p_val_adj) * avg_log2FC
    ) %>%
    select(-X)


log_info("Load Xenium DE results...")
DE_markers_xenium <- readRDS(params$DE_markers_Xenium) %>%
    remove_rownames() %>%
    mutate(
        p_val_adj = ifelse(p_val_adj == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_val_adj),
        score = -log10(p_val_adj) * avg_log2FC,
    )
```

```{r}
log_info("Extract cell type markers for cell types of interest...")
# ---- OPTION 1: assign gene to cell type based on -log10(p-adj) x avglog2FC ----
scRNAseq_markers <- DE_markers_scRNAseq %>%
    # Manual filtering
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > log2(1.5), p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    # Force genes to only occur once (based on -log10(p-adj) * avg_log2FC)
    arrange(desc(score)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

scRNAseq_markers %>% count(cluster)

xenium_markers <- DE_markers_xenium %>%
    arrange(desc(score)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > log2(1.5), p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(score)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Final filtering ----
scRNAseq_markers <- scRNAseq_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    # Select top-15 genes as markers for each cell type
    slice_max(order_by = score, n = params$top_n) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(cluster)

common_markers <- xenium_markers %>%
    # Annotate xenium markers using the selected scRNAseq markers
    left_join(scRNAseq_markers, by = c("cluster", "gene")) %>%
    # Only keep xenium genes that are annotated based on cluster (cell type) and gene
    filter(!is.na(p_val_adj.y)) %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, seurat_obj$cell_type %>% unique() %>% sort())) %>%
    arrange(cluster) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    # Select top-15 genes as markers for each cell type
    slice_max(order_by = score.x, n = 2) %>%
    ungroup()


gene_list <- lapply(common_markers$cluster %>% unique(), function(x) {
    common_markers %>%
        filter(cluster == x) %>%
        pull(gene)
})

names(gene_list) <- common_markers$cluster %>% unique()

p <- DotPlot(seurat_obj,
    features = gene_list,
    group.by = "cell_type", dot.scale = 12,
    assay = "RNA", scale = TRUE
) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    scale_color_gradient2(
        low = GBMutils::load_color_palette("Divergent_1")["low"],
        high = GBMutils::load_color_palette("Divergent_1")["high"]
    ) +
    labs(x = "Marker gene", y = "Cell type")
p
ggsave(p, filename = glue("{params$sample_id}__celltypemarkers_top{params$top_n}_dot.pdf"), path = params$output_dir)
```
